Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly inferred that the birthplace was "Okinawa City" based on a misinterpretation of the text "Naha, Okinawa, Japan". Naha is the capital and largest city of Okinawa Prefecture, but it is not "Okinawa City". The Planner failed to correctly extract the city name "Naha" from the source text ("Born September 20, 1977, in Naha, Okinawa, Japan") and instead hallucinated or confused the prefecture name with the city name, leading to the wrong final answer "Okinawa City, Okinawa, Japan" instead of the correct "Naha, Okinawa, Japan".
